doc: The declared reach of this organism. Everything absent from these lists is denied. Editing this file is an act of authority, not of computation: no cell, no learning rule and no self-improvement path may write it.

venue.doc: The trading use case, paper only. enabled is false here and every list is empty, so the shipped organism may not replay a tape and may not place an order of any kind. A bench or a test hands its own policy object. paper true is not a setting to change: world/policy.mjs refuses every order when it is anything else, and there is no live order path in world/venue.mjs to switch to.
